---
name: "nf-core/fastq_contam_seqtk_kraken"
description: "Produces a contamination report from FastQ input after subsampling"
keywords:
- "statistics"
- "fastq"
- "contamination"
components:
- "kraken2/kraken2"
- "seqtk/sample"
input:
- ch_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "List of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
      \ data, respectively.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(reads) ]\n"
- sample_size:
    type: "string"
    description: "Number of reads to subsample for contamination detection."
- kraken2_db:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Kraken2 database used for contamination screening."
output:
- reports:
    type: "file"
    description: "Kraken2 contamination report.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(report)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "Subsampled FastQ files as produced by seqtk sample.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(reads) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
authors:
- "@apeltzer"
maintainers:
- "@apeltzer"
version: "0.0.0-ea78fd3"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/kraken2/kraken2@0.0.0-0c0f63f"
  - "nf-core/seqtk/sample@0.0.0-ea78fd3"
